logic_errors.authority: Advertised duplicate ID fail-closed guarantee; native itemdb.cpp:ItemDatabase::parseBodyNode identifies database rows by Id before applying Type.

suggestions: Add fixture tests for null projected masks, source-native level bound rejection and duplicate identity collisions involving excluded rows; do not weaken the new unpriced consumer tests.

Clarify that Jobs/Classes/Gender/Locations are raw declarations. itemdb.cpp:1227-1247 forces instruments male, whips female and wedding rings by ID; adapter does not normalize these, which is acceptable only under its explicit no-compatibility claim.

Path check blocks cross-directory/ruleset file symlinks and symlink ruleset directories, but allows a leaf symlink resolving within the selected ruleset directory. Avoid claiming universal symlink rejection.
Exact class Job strings are not validated against native JOB constants (pc.cpp:13429-13433). Unknown reference handling is strict, but unknown standalone Job is outside verified source semantics.
Direct parent precedence and excluded parent-entry semantics are implemented correctly, but a dedicated multi-parent precedence regression fixture would strengthen existing tests.
